# appraisal quality

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:appraisalQuality`](gmeow-appraisalQuality.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/appraisalQuality>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/affect`](../../slices/affect.md)

The aesthetic quality a qualitative appraisal reads. NOT functional: one cell may attribute several coexisting qualities. Open vocabulary (sh:nodeKind sh:IRI).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Appraisal`](../classes/gmeow-Appraisal.md) -> [`gmeow:AestheticQuality`](../classes/gmeow-AestheticQuality.md)
